reason: The plugin is primarily an automation utility for DeepSeek Harness users to drive local Godot 4.x workflows. Evidence from the README and package metadata shows its main purpose is exposing agent-callable tools for headless project checks/imports/runs, asset listing, editor launch, and runtime tool toggling.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一组本地 Godot 4.x 工具，可在会话中调用 headless 校验、重导入、运行场景/脚本、列出资源文件并启动编辑器。
summaries.en: This plugin adds DeepSeek Harness tools for local Godot 4.x workflows, letting users run headless checks, reimport assets, execute scenes or scripts, list project resources, and open the editor.

capabilities: Invokes and controls a local Godot 4.x executable through a configurable executable path
Runs headless Godot operations for project validation, import, scene execution, and script execution
Launches the local Godot editor UI from the plugin
Supports session-level toggling of tool availability

reasons.code: README states the plugin provides native agent tools that drive local Godot 4.x executable functions including headless CLI and editor launcher.
Tool list explicitly includes godot_check, godot_import, godot_run_scene, godot_run_script, godot_list_assets, godot_open_editor, and godot_toggle.
Package metadata declares a DSH bundle with patch entry, confirming plugin packaging and runtime integration.
